title: LEAVIN' ON MY MIND
author: Rusty Goodman
stanzas: Let not your heart be troubled, I hear the master say, I'm coming back to take you home Just follow Me and pray To leave here any time, Cause all I've been getting lately is Leavin' on my mind

Oh yes, I'm really lookin' For a better place to live I just can't seem to get excited About the world and what it can give I couldn't care less if I could buy it all with a solitary dime.For what good would the world do me with leavin' on my mind
I'm heading home- I'm going home, Nothing here can keep me from my home, I'm heading home, I'm going home,Lately I've got leavin' Leavin' on my mind. Lately I've got leavin' Leavin' on my mind
chorus: Lately all I got is leavin' on my mind. Seems that's all I'm thinkin' 'bout Most all the time. But soon and very soon I'll leave my troubles far behind Lately i've got leavin', leavin' on my mind
